Term1: PROCED FOR INFECTED SKIN, SKIN STRUCTURES
Text:
## ANTIMICROBIALS FOR PATIENTS UNDERGOING PROCEDURES THAT INVOLVE INFECTED SKIN,
## SKIN STRUCTURES, OR INFECTED MUSCULOSKELETAL TISSUE TO PREVENT ENDOCARDITIS
## Inpatient

## Pathogen unknown or possibly MSSA or beta-hemolytic streptococcus
## Patients unable to take oral medications
## Suspected MRSA
[Trimethoprim/Sulfamethoxazole 1 DS table PO 1 hour before incision](psjzid-trimethoprim-sulfa-1-ds-po-pre-op)
($) [R,DI]
< OR >
[Minocycline 100 mg PO 1 hour before incision ($) [DI]](psjzid-minocycline-100-mg-po-pre-op)
< OR >
## Outpatient

## Pathogen unknown or possibly MSSA or beta-hemolytic streptococcus
[Cephalexin 2 gm PO 1 hour before procedure ($) [R]](psozid-cephalexin-2000mg-po-once)
## Patients unable to take oral medications
Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS for parenteral prophylaxis
## Suspected MRSA
Trimethoprim/Sulfamethoxazole 1 DS table PO 1 hour before incision
($) [R,DI]
< OR >
Minocycline 100 mg PO 1 hour before incision ($) [DI]
< OR >
Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS for parenteral prophylaxis
